    A⁽²⁾ = 𝔽₂P (Section 10) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "Its projective corner End(⊕_x P_x)^op is A⁽²⁾: a nonzero homogeneous projective Hom is one-dimensional over 𝔽₂, and every nonzero product coefficient is one."

    The form functor of C⁽²⁾ → k(Γ_A) gives an injective ring map ι₂ : A⁽²⁾ → A₀ on the projective corners (ι₂), and 𝔽₂-independent families stay k-independent (linearIndependent_ι₂). For each ray t of A₀ (with its normed basis vector b_t) the corner of A⁽²⁾ at the endpoints of t in the length degree of t contains exactly one nonzero vector e_t (eT); ι₂ e_t is a nonzero multiple of b_t. The e_t form a multiplicative basis of A⁽²⁾ with the multiplication table of A₀, hence 𝔽₂P ≅ A⁽²⁾ (Θ₂).
